plain: There is a book called The Controllers by a writer named Martin Cannon. Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says on one episode that a man named John Alexander apparently threatened Cannon when he wrote it. A researcher named Greg Malatzi brings up the same book on a later episode, though he says nothing about a threat. He says the book is mainly about the idea that alien abductions, the reports of people being taken by aliens, were fabricated. Michels and Malatzi bring it up because, if the book is right, some abduction stories could be human-made, and the reported threat would suggest someone wanted that idea kept quiet.
